facts.text: The original period details of the manor house are combined with contemporary luxury touches.
facts.excerpt: The original period details of the manor house merge harmoniously with the contemporary luxury touches one would expect to find from a luxury resort

facts.text: The house was formerly the home of the Earls of Kildare and dates back to the 1700s.
facts.excerpt: Formerly the home of the Earls of Kildare, the house dates back to the 1700s

facts.text: The house was the filming location for the BBC miniseries "The Aristocrats".
facts.excerpt: was the filming location for the BBC miniseries, "The Aristocrats"

facts.text: The property covers 1,100 acres with expansive park land and walking paths.
facts.excerpt: The 1,100-acre property has expansive park land with walking paths

facts.text: The grounds include bluebell-lined pathways, small streams and a medieval tower.
facts.excerpt: Vast grassy knolls, bluebell-lined pathways, small streams and a medieval tower stir your imagination.

facts.text: Dublin International Airport is 32km from Carton House via the M50/M4 motorways.
facts.excerpt: Dublin International Airport is located just 32km from Carton House via the M50/M4 motorways.

facts.text: The hotel can arrange a private airport transfer for guests, with quotations available on request.
facts.excerpt: Carton House can happily arrange a private transfer to and/or from the Airport for guests. Quotations available upon request.

facts.text: Carton House is in Maynooth, on the Western Suburban Railway Line, which serves three Dublin city centre stations.
facts.excerpt: Carton House is located in Maynooth and lies on the Western Suburban Railway Line which serves three City Centre stations

facts.text: A taxi from Maynooth Station to Carton House takes approximately 5 minutes.
facts.excerpt: A taxi journey from Maynooth Station to Carton House will take approximately 5 minutes.

facts.text: Carton House offers complimentary car parking on resort for all guests and visitors.
facts.excerpt: Carton House offers complimentary car parking on resort for all guests and visitors.

facts.text: Valet parking is available on request for an additional charge.
